summary: NOVONIX Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing ASX waivers for its Share Purchase Plan (SPP), part of a capital raising disclosed on 17 June 2026. The SPP offers shares at A$0.16, a ~31.2% discount to the 5-day VWAP, exceeding the standard 20% limit. The ASX waivers permit issuance without shareholder approval and allow director participation, with the number of SPP shares capped at 30% of existing shares. This is a non-US filing; the 6-K serves as the SEC-equivalent disclosure. Watch for investor participation uptake and potential dilution to existing holders.
